Historical native emitted-G-code verification confirmed fan advance and proportional kick-start after fixing long-move splitting and exact-boundary restoration. A 0 to 60% fan increase with kick-start 0.1 s gives 0.06 s at full PWM. Timing is based on commanded linear feedrate, not measured fan RPM or acceleration/arc-aware firmware time. A zero minimum PWM removes the speed floor without disabling cooling. Saved projects and custom user-preset overrides remain unchanged. The common emitted-layer plan now omits empty output planes, so they cannot trigger an extra cooling-layer transition. Built-in values and fan timing algorithms are unchanged; fan-insertion split points around a removed empty plane need not remain byte-identical.
